title: The launch: whether and when, before or after the wind-down
summary: Whether and when to launch (before or after the wind-down) is part of transition/PLAN.md's yes (card a-wind-down-plan). outreach/launch.md is still a draft for Dinis to edit: when, to which groups, and the open letter in his voice. Nothing is sent. incident.envoy@ owns outreach now, not incident.media@. incident.envoy@ asks, in its words: outreach: who is it for first, in whose voice, and when does it go (a quiet opening today, or nothing until the warnings end)?
closes: Your edits to the draft and a time.
blocks: Nobody outside the team has been told the site exists.
